description: You helped operate an amateur radio station during ARRL Field Day. Your handwritten contact log needs to be organized in a spreadsheet. Open /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/fieldday_raw_log.xlsx containing 24 contacts with messy formatting. Standardize the data: (1) Convert time column A to 24-hour HH:MM format, (2) Convert frequency column B to MHz decimal format, (3) Normalize mode column C (convert USB/LSB to SSB, keep CW/FT8), (4) Add column G 'Band' deriving from frequency (7.0-7.3=40m, 14.0-14.35=20m, 21.0-21.45=15m), (5) Add column H 'Points' with formula (CW/FT8=2 points, else 1), (6) Add column I 'Duplicate' marking 'DUP' if same callsign appears earlier on same band, (7) Create summary starting at row 28 showing total contacts, valid contacts, and total points. Save as fieldday_score.xlsx.
